p.i: Non certè illius pascua vituperabit bubulcus, Vel quicunque fistula corneam habentem vngulam Panem celebrans Oues in agro stabulantes sequitur: neque sane syluam, Omnigenam fructuum vituperaritis, qui operam ponit circa plantas. Talis in illa cultura ad producendum Herbam, & pascua florida, atque etiam hominum Stirpem, pulcherrimámque immortalibus similem. Huius quidem ad Boream pinge solum habitant Homines Armeniique, & comminus habitātes Matiani, Matiani. In montibus siti, fluuium ante Euphratem, Pingues, opulentique, & Martis bene gnari.
Arma ducum dirimens miserando funere Crassus Assyrias Latio maculauit sanguine Carrhas.

main_text.head: ASIÆ DESCRIPTIO EIVS, QVÆ intra mare Caspium, Indum fluuium, & mare tum Persicum, tum Indicum continetur.
main_text.p: Quin agite, Eoum comites properemus in orbem. Lucan.lib.8. Diuidit Euphrates ingentem gurgite mundum, Caspiaque immensos seducunt claustra recessus, Verg.lib.2. Georg. Necpulcher Ganges, atque auro turbidus Hermus Laudibus Italia certent.

page.notes: Right margin notes are partly faint and show-through; readings of the marginal references are approximate. The woodcut band is an ornament and not transcribed. The initial Q is a large woodcut letter joined to "uin".
